record.file_problem: The provided text contains repository metadata, README, and file list only; the referenced WHITEPAPER.md contents are not included.
record.tranche_reason: The README reports results from a weight edit that removes a harvested refusal direction, a different intervention from projecting the direction out of activations.
record.gate_note: The README reports a refusal-rate result and preserved capability results. It does not report adding the direction, test jailbreak suppression or robustness training, or provide the referenced whitepaper or detailed evaluation outputs.
record.test_reason: The repository applies the original paper's weight-orthogonalization recipe to a new setting, Meta's hybrid vision-language Muse-Glimmer-30B. It reports the resulting refusal rate and capability checks, which bear on V2 and on V1's removal half. This is not T2: the original paper already converts directional ablation into a weight edit, so the method is not new. It is not T4 either, because the reported outcome is refusal removal itself, which is what V2 asserts. Evidence is thin: README summaries only, a 7-prompt probe, and no uncertainty.
record.authors_conclusion: The paraphrase is essentially correct. It should add that the authors frame their contribution as engineering (VLM writer-tensor targeting, the bf16 NaN trap, verification methodology) rather than a scientific test. They state that the technique is already public.
record.recipe_differences: This is a tool repository, not identified as a replication. It harvests a refusal direction from contrastive prompts and orthogonalizes 105 writer weight matrices, rather than testing the original activation-projection intervention.
record.problems: Evidence in the provided text is limited to README summaries; detailed methods and evaluation results in the referenced whitepaper are absent. The refusal probe has only 7 prompts, and no uncertainty, unedited capability baselines, or control results are reported.
record.rows_left_out: No additional reported results omitted. The repository file list names evaluation scripts but does not itself show their results.

untested.parts: Adding the direction to induce refusal. Activation-level ablation across all layers and positions. Any standard capability benchmark with an unedited baseline.
Removal across multiple released models. A refusal benchmark of meaningful size. Effects on general capability benchmarks.

missing.what: The full method and results: direction selection, layer choice, per-layer evaluations and full eval outputs. The README states these are in the whitepaper, which is not in the provided text.
The README's statement that a bf16-to-GGUF conversion injects NaN into ffn_down; f16 conversion is required. This is a toolchain hazard, not a result on refusal.

record.verdict_notes: This is a tool repository with 0 stars, not a study. All numbers are README summaries without baselines for capability, uncertainty or controls. The tranche was changed from T2 to T3 because weight orthogonalization is the original paper's own method; the new element is the VLM setting. Contrastive prompt data and edited weights are not included.

versions.untested_parts: The README reports removal but not addition of the direction; it does not test projection at every layer and position.
The abliterated weights are not hosted in the repository; the README reports a local weight-edit result, not performance across multiple released models.
